blocks.text: Standard hydrogen electrode (SHE) un kai qism ke half-cells mein se ek hai jo reference (muqable ke) electrode ke taur par istemal ho sakte hain. Figure 10.4 standard hydrogen electrode dikhati hai.
Is electrode mein yeh cheezen hain:

items: 101 kPa pressure par hydrogen gas, jo 1.00 mol dm⁻³ concentration ke H⁺ ions ke saath equilibrium mein hai
Platinum black se dhaka hua platinum electrode, jo hydrogen gas aur H⁺ ions dono ko chhoota hai.

blocks.text: Platinum black bareek pisa hua (finely divided) platinum hai; yeh hydrogen gas aur solution ke H⁺ ions ko qareeb laata hai taake H₂ gas aur H⁺ ions ka equilibrium jaldi qaim ho. Platinum electrode inert (be-asar) hai, is liye reaction mein hissa nahi leta. Tamam half-cells ki standard electrode potential (E°) values isi electrode ke muqable mein napi jati hain.

blocks.alt: Standard hydrogen electrode. Shishe ki nali jis ke pehlu mein 'Hydrogen gas supply at 1 atm pressure' ka raasta hai, H+ (1 mol/dm3) solution wale beaker mein khari hai. Platinum ki taar nali mein neeche kaale platinum electrode tak jati hai. Neeche nali phail kar shishe ki 'ghanti' (bell) banti hai jis ke soorakh se H2 bulbulon ki shakal mein bahar nikalti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.4: Standard hydrogen electrode (SHE) (kitab ki Figure 10.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Hydrogen gas 1 atm par nali mein aati hai aur sheeshe ki 'bell' ke neeche platinum electrode ke oopar se bulbule bana kar nikalti hai; wahin H₂ aur H⁺ ka equilibrium banta hai. Kitab ki figure mein concentration ‘1mol/dm⁺³’ chhapi hai; sahi 1 mol/dm³ (1.00 mol dm⁻³) hai, jaisa kitab ka apna matan kehta hai.
Jab SHE ko kisi doosre half-cell se joda jaye to voltmeter ki reading us half-cell ka standard electrode potential hoti hai. Hydrogen electrode ki half-equation yun likhi ja sakti hai:

Half-equation ko kis tarah balance kiya jaye (ya kis taraf likha jaye), is se E° ki value par koi farq nahi parta, kyun ke equation element ke electrons lene ke rujhan (tendency) ko nahi badalti. Is ka voltage apni marzi se (arbitrarily) 0.00 V muqarrar kiya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt: Platinum ko platinum black se kyun dhaka jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Platinum black bareek zarron ki wajah se bohat bari satah (surface) deta hai, jahan H₂ gas aur H⁺ ions ka rabta jaldi hota hai aur equilibrium jaldi qaim ho jata hai.

items: SHE: 1.00 mol dm⁻³ H⁺ mein platinum black par 101 kPa H₂.
2H⁺ + 2e⁻ ⇌ H₂, E° = 0.00 V (muqarrar); sab E° values isi ke muqable mein.
